name: HCTRA EZ TAG (Harris County Toll Road Authority)
notes: Researched from the public hctra.org home page and FAQ list (a JavaScript app, read in a browser; no sign-in, no plate search). EZ TAG accounts are funded by credit/debit card or EFT (bank); a secondary card can back up the primary card; three lifetime insufficient-funds EFT transactions remove the EFT option. Typical accounts (1-2 vehicles) open with a $10 prepaid deposit, replenish $20 when the balance falls to $5 or below; 3-4 vehicles $40/$10, 5-6 $60/$15, 7-8 $80/$20. Up to eight tags free, $2.00 activation fee per tag after that. Missed tolls can be paid online by plate before they are invoiced; three or more unpaid tolls can bring a Toll Violation Invoice at a higher rate plus fees. Free tolls for qualifying Veteran and disabled peace officer plates. The FAQ pages read do not describe payment plans, statements delivery or how to close an account, so those keep catalog defaults; HCTRA also now serves TxTag customers. Reviewer (2026-10-09): FAQ answers re-read in a browser (expanded accordions). Table: 1-2 vehicles $10 deposit / $5 threshold; 3-4 $40/$10; 5-6 $60/$15; 7-8 $80/$20; max $600/$300. The 'autopay' help paragraph previously mislabelled the thresholds as replenishment amounts; fixed. Home page also promotes EZ Tollpay (cash at retailers). Reviewer (2026-10-09, run 2): the catalog's synthetic 3/6/12-month online payment plan was removed (payment_arrangement unsupported, evidence inferred): no official page read, nor a web search, describes an installment plan for this agency, so the mock now points to customer service instead.

sources.title: HCTRA - Harris County Toll Road Authority (home)

autopay.note: Your card or bank account is charged the replenishment amount (typically $20) when the balance falls to $5 or below.

guest_pay.note: Missed tolls and Toll Violation Invoices can be paid online by license plate without an EZ TAG account.

payment_assistance.note: Qualifying Veteran and disabled peace officer plates travel HCTRA toll roads free.

payment_arrangement.note: No online payment plan is described. Pay missed tolls or invoices in full under Pay Tolls & Invoices, or call HCTRA at 281-875-EASY (3279) about a balance or a fee reduction.

help.title: Auto replenishment and minimum balance
paragraphs: EZ TAG is a prepaid account. The required replenishment and low-balance amounts depend on how many active vehicles are on the account.
A typical account with up to two vehicles replenishes $20: when tolls bring the balance to $5 or below, the card or bank account on file is charged $20 automatically.

Larger accounts have higher thresholds: replenishment starts at a $10 balance for 3-4 vehicles, $15 for 5-6 and $20 for 7-8, and the replenishment amount grows with the vehicle count (up to a $600 deposit and $300 threshold). The EZ TAG Agreement has the full table, and adding an EZ Plate vehicle can raise the amount.

help.title: How much an EZ TAG costs
paragraphs: Opening an EZ TAG account takes a prepaid toll deposit: $10 for 1-2 vehicles, $40 for 3-4, $60 for 5-6 and $80 for 7-8. Up to eight tags per account are free; each tag after that has a $2.00 activation fee.
EZ TAG pays the lowest toll rate and works across Texas, Kansas, Oklahoma, Florida and Colorado.

help.title: Forms of payment
paragraphs: EZ TAG accepts credit or debit cards and electronic funds transfer (EFT) from a bank account. Card customers can add a secondary card that is used if the primary card is declined.

EFT payments that bounce carry an insufficient funds fee, and after three insufficient-funds transactions in an account's lifetime EFT is no longer allowed and a credit card is required. Keep card numbers and expiration dates current to avoid toll violations.

help.title: Missed tolls and Toll Violation Invoices
paragraphs: If you drive through a tolling point without a funded EZ TAG or other accepted tag, pay the missed toll online under Pay Tolls & Invoices by searching your license plate, before it is invoiced at a higher rate.

When three or more unpaid tolls build up, a Toll Violation Invoice may be mailed to the registered owner with tolls at the higher invoiced rate plus fees. Pay it online, in person at an EZ TAG store, or ask customer service for help with the plate, state and invoice number ready.
Leaving violations unresolved can bring fines, referral to collections and loss of eligibility to renew the vehicle registration. If you think an invoice is wrong, call 281-875-3279.

help.title: Discounted and free tolls
paragraphs: Texas-registered vehicles with qualifying plates (such as Disabled Veteran, Purple Heart, Medal of Honor, Legion of Valor and Disabled Peace Officer) travel HCTRA toll roads free automatically; METRO HOT express lanes need a separate application.
For other drivers, HCTRA's main savings are the EZ TAG rate, free tags and a low opening deposit. EZ Tollpay also lets drivers pay with cash at participating retailers such as Walmart and H-E-B.
